title: 第15章 太阴体第16章 得去血色禁地
slug: 合欢宗从照顾师弟道侣开始修仙
content_zh:
李蒙扫了一眼道童。
【戚薇】
【年龄19】
【气运800】
【修为练气五层】
【资质太阴体】
【好感0】
“太阴体？”
李蒙眼中闪过了一丝惊讶。
这是什么体质？
难道她长不大的原因与体质有关？
李蒙转身走向了休息区。
在茶桌旁坐了下来。
“这样特殊体质的道童怎会出现在千宝楼的二楼？”
李蒙瞥了一眼不远处的守楼人。
这一看，李蒙心神震动。
系统竟然无法显示其信息。
“元婴修士？”
李蒙低着头，用视线的余光打量着那个守楼者。
他身上散发着一股很奇异的气息。

应该是用了改变容貌的神通。
身上也散发着不似男人的阴柔之气。
“该不会是合欢宗传闻中的阴阳老魔吧！”
李蒙拿着茶杯的手一颤。
不可能，太上长老怎会出现在千宝楼这种地方。
就算是来散散心的，应该也会前往更高的楼层。
“师兄，师兄，你的灵植准备好了！”
长的白净而又可爱的童女小跑着向李蒙走了过来。
不远处茶桌旁的守楼者手指微微一动。
“呀！”
道童就好像被什么绊了一下。
小小的身体一个踉跄扑进了李蒙怀中。
李蒙连忙抱住了道童。
“小师妹，你没事吧？”
李蒙的声音有些沙哑。
道童就好像受了惊的小兔子。
连忙从李蒙怀中站了起来。
“我……我没事，师兄，你没事吧。”
李蒙呵呵一笑，放下了手中的茶杯。
“我很好，没事！”

“真没事？”
content_en:
Li Meng glanced at the Taoist boy.
【Qi Wei】
【Age 19】
【Lucky 800】
[Fifth level of Qi cultivation]
【Qualification Taiyin Body】
【Favorable 0】
"Taiyin body?"
A trace of surprise flashed in Li Meng's eyes.
What kind of physique is this?
Could it be that the reason why she doesn't grow up is related to her physical constitution?
Li Meng turned and walked towards the rest area.
Sat down at the tea table.
"How could a Taoist boy with such a special physique appear on the second floor of Qianbao Tower?"
Li Meng glanced at the building guard not far away.
Seeing this, Li Meng was shocked.
The system is unable to display its information.
"Nascent Soul cultivator?"
Li Meng lowered his head and looked at the building guard with his peripheral vision.
He exuded a very strange aura.
He must have used the magical power to change his appearance.
He also exudes a feminine aura that is not like that of a man.
"Could it be the Yin-Yang Old Demon in the Hehuan Sect's rumors?"
Li Meng's hand holding the tea cup trembled.
Impossible, how could the Supreme Elder appear in a place like Qianbao Tower.
Even if they came here to relax, they would probably go to a higher floor.
"Senior brother, senior brother, your spiritual plant is ready!"
The fair and cute girl trotted towards Li Meng.
The guard at the tea table not far away moved his fingers slightly.
"Yeah!"
The Taoist boy seemed to be tripped over something.
The small body stumbled into Li Meng's arms.
Li Meng quickly hugged Tao Tong.
"Junior sister, are you okay?"
Li Meng's voice was a little hoarse.
The Taoist boy is like a frightened little rabbit.
He quickly stood up from Li Meng's arms.
"I...I'm fine, senior brother, are you okay?"
Li Meng chuckled and put down the teacup in his hand.
"I'm fine, it's okay!"
"Is everything okay?"
